enDef: to make plans or arrangements for something that will happen in the future

example.en: The prosecution wanted more time to prepare their case.
example.cn: 原告想要有更多的时间来准备诉讼。

cn: 政党，党派；聚会，派对；当事人 [复数 parties]
enDef: a social event when a lot of people meet together to enjoy themselves by eating, drinking, dancing etc

example.en: We’re having a small party this evening to celebrate our wedding anniversary.
example.cn: 我们今晚有个小聚会，庆祝我们的结婚纪念日。

enDef: the process of making air, water, soil etc dangerously dirty and not suitable for people to use, or the state of being dangerously dirty

example.en: California’s tough anti-pollution laws
example.cn: 加利福尼亚州严厉的反污染法

enDef: to behave as if something is true when in fact you know it is not, in order to deceive people or for fun

example.en: Let’s pretend we’re on the moon.
example.cn: 我们假装自己是在月球上吧。

enDef: someone whose job is to collect and deliver letters

example.en: Is he a tall postman? Yes, he is.
example.cn: 他是一个高的邮递员吗？是的，他是。

enDef: to choose a person or thing, for example because they are the best or most suitable

example.en: Students have to pick three courses from a list of 15.
example.cn: 学生必须从15门课中选修3门。

enDef: a building where people are kept as a punishment for a crime, or while they are waiting to go to court for their  trial

example.en: He visits his dad in prison every week.
example.cn: 他每周都去探望狱中的父亲。

cn: 照片，图画；影片；景色；化身
enDef: shapes, lines etc painted or drawn on a surface, showing what someone or something looks like

example.en: The room had several pictures on the walls.
example.cn: 那个房间墙上有几幅画。

enDef: an amount of something that has been separated from the main part

example.en: Cut off a piece of wood 5 cm in length.
example.cn: 截下一段五厘米长的木头。

cn: 印刷业；印花布；印刷字体；印章；印记
enDef: writing that has been printed, for example in books or newspapers

example.en: There was no print at all on the backs of the tickets.
example.cn: 门票背面没有印任何文字。

enDef: to take a photograph of someone or something

example.en: Kate agreed to let me photograph her.
example.cn: 凯特同意让我为她拍照。

cn: 警方， 警察； 治安
enDef: the people who work for an official organization whose job is to catch criminals and make sure that people obey the law

example.en: Police surrounded the courthouse.
example.cn: 警察围在法院大楼四周。

cn: (女士)手提袋；(国家、家庭、团体等的) 财力
enDef: a bag in which a woman carries her money and personal things

example.en: I locked the door and dropped the keys in my purse.
example.cn: 我锁上门，然后把钥匙丢进手提包里。

cn: 工厂，车间；植物；设备；庄稼
enDef: a living thing that has leaves and roots and grows in earth, especially one that is smaller than a tree

example.en: Don’t forget to water the plants.
example.cn: 别忘记给植物浇水。

enDef: to make someone happy or satisfied

example.en: a business that wants to please its customers
example.cn: 希望让顾客满意的一家公司

enDef: to give someone money for something you buy or for a service

example.en: How would you like to pay?
example.cn: 你想怎么付款？

cn: 油漆；绘画；装饰；涂色于；描绘；（用语言，文字等）描写；擦脂粉等
enDef: to put paint on a surface

example.en: The ceiling needs painting.
example.cn: 天花板需要粉刷了。

cn: 部分；角色；零件；一些；片段
enDef: a piece or feature of something such as an object, area, event, or period of time

example.en: For part of the day, you will be outside doing practical work.
example.cn: 你们每天将有一部分时间在户外实际操作。

enDef: a sweet juicy fruit that has a round base and is thinner near the top, or the tree that produces this fruit

example.en: Pick an orange, pick a pear.
example.cn: 摘一个橙子，摘一个梨子。

enDef: a situation in which there is no war or fighting

example.en: The country is at peace with its neighbours for the first time in years.
example.cn: 这是多年来该国与其邻国第一次和平共处。

enDef: to show that something is true by providing facts, information etc

example.en: You’re wrong, and I can prove it.
example.cn: 你错了，我可以证明。

cn: 做， 履行， 完成； 演出， 表演
enDef: to do something to entertain people, for example by acting a play or playing a piece of music

example.en: Chenier and the band are performing at the Silver Palace tomorrow.
example.cn: 车尼尔和乐队明天将在银宫演出。

enDef: to put something into your pocket

example.en: Maggie locked the door and pocketed the keys.
example.cn: 玛吉锁上门，把钥匙放进口袋里。

enDef: to be the first person to do, invent or use something

example.en: The new cancer treatment was pioneered in the early eighties by Dr Sylvia Bannerjee.
example.cn: 这种新的癌症治疗方法是由西尔维娅·班纳基医生在80年代初期开创的。

cn: 钢笔； 圆珠笔； 围栏
enDef: an instrument for writing or drawing with ink

example.en: a ballpoint pen
example.cn: 圆珠笔

cn: 学生；[解剖] 瞳孔；未成年人
enDef: someone who is being taught, especially a child

example.en: About 20 pupils study music here.
example.cn: 大约20名小学生在这里学习音乐。

cn: 宠爱的， 表示亲昵的
enDef: Someone's pet theory, project, or subject is one that they particularly support or like

example.en: He would not stand by and let his pet project be killed off.
example.cn: 他不会袖手旁观，任由自己钟爱的项目被否决。

cn: 流行的，通俗的；受欢迎的；大众的；普及的
enDef: liked by a lot of people

example.en: Hilary was popular at school.
example.cn: 希拉里在学校里很受欢迎。

cn: 时间， 时期， 时代； 学时， 课时； 句号， 句点
enDef: a particular length of time with a beginning and an end

example.en: Tomorrow’s weather will be dry with sunny periods.
example.cn: 明天天气干燥，间或晴朗。

enDef: to have a picnic

example.en: We picnicked on the beach.
example.cn: 我们在海滩上野餐。

enDef: pale red

example.en: Hannah’s face went pink.
example.cn: 汉娜的脸上泛起了红晕。

cn: 产品， 产物； 乘积
enDef: something that is grown or made in a factory in large quantities, usually in order to be sold

example.en: The London factory assembles the finished product .
example.cn: 伦敦工厂组装成品。

cn: 父亲（或母亲）；父母亲；根源
enDef: the father or mother of a person or animal

example.en: Children under 14 should be accompanied by a parent.
example.cn: 14 岁以下儿童须由一位家长陪同。

enDef: to remove the skin from fruit or vegetables

example.en: Peel and dice the potatoes.
example.cn: 把马铃薯去皮并切成丁。

cn: 生产， 制造； 展现， 出示； 上演， 制作
enDef: to cause a particular result or effect

example.en: New drugs are producing remarkable results .
example.cn: 新药正在产生显著的效果。

enDef: fruit baked inside a  pastry  covering

example.en: I had a steak and kidney pie with chips.
example.cn: 我吃了一份牛肉腰子馅饼加薯条。

enDef: to use your hands to make something or someone move towards you or in the direction that your hands are moving

example.en: Mom! Davey’s pulling my hair!
example.cn: 妈妈! 戴维拽我的头发！

cn: 快乐；希望；娱乐；令人高兴的事
enDef: the feeling of happiness, enjoyment, or satisfaction that you get from an experience

example.en: the simple pleasures of life
example.cn: 生活中的简单乐趣

cn: 丰富， 充足， 大量
enDef: a situation in which there is a lot of food and goods available for people

example.en: a land of plenty
example.cn: 一片富饶的土地

enDef: to give something to someone or make it available to them, because they need it or want it

example.en: Tea and biscuits will be provided.
example.cn: 有茶水和饼干供应。

enDef: material in the form of thin sheets that is used for writing on, wrapping things etc

example.en: I’ll get you a piece of paper so you can write the number down.
example.cn: 我给你找张纸，你好把号码写下来。

enDef: an object that is made from two similar parts that are joined together

example.en: earrings, £5 a pair
example.cn: 耳环，5英镑一副

cn: 囚犯，犯人；俘虏；刑事被告
enDef: someone who is kept in a prison as a legal punishment for a crime or while they are waiting for their  trial

example.en: Relationships between the staff and the prisoners are good.
example.cn: 狱警和犯人相处良好。

cn: 同情， 怜悯； 可惜， 遗憾
enDef: used to show that you are disappointed about something and you wish things could happen differently

example.en: It’s a great pity Joyce wasn’t invited.
example.cn: 乔伊斯没有受到邀请太遗憾了。

enDef: a card that can be sent in the post without an envelope, especially one with a picture on it

example.en: Don’t forget to send us a postcard!
example.cn: 别忘了给我们寄张明信片！

cn: 压， 按， 挤； 压榨， 压迫； 催促， 逼迫
enDef: to push something firmly against a surface

example.en: Manville kept his back pressed flat against the wall.
example.cn: 曼维尔后背紧紧地贴在墙上。

cn: 捆扎， 打包； 挤在一起； 塞满
enDef: to put things into cases, bags etc ready for a trip somewhere

example.en: I forgot to pack my razor.
example.cn: 我忘记把剃须刀放入行李包了。

cn: 有礼貌的， 客气的； 有教养的， 文雅的
enDef: behaving or speaking in a way that is correct for the social situation you are in, and showing that you are careful to consider other people’s needs and feelings

example.en: She’s always very polite.
example.cn: 她总是很有礼貌。

cn: 大概， 或许， 很可能
enDef: If you say that something is probably the case, you think that it is likely to be the case, although you are not sure

example.en: The White House probably won't make this plan public until July.
example.cn: 白宫可能要到7月份才会公布这项计划。

enDef: to think that someone or something is very important or valuable

example.en: He has spent months cultivating what he hopes are prize flowers.
example.cn: 他花了几个月培育他认为有望获奖的花卉品种。

cn: 旅客；乘客；过路人；碍手碍脚的人
enDef: someone who is travelling in a vehicle, plane, boat etc, but is not driving it or working on it

example.en: Neither the driver nor the passengers were hurt.
example.cn: 司机和乘客均未受伤。

cn: 突然[出人意料]地从〔某物〕中出来，蹦出，离开，脱落
enDef: to come suddenly or unexpectedly out of or away from something

example.en: The lid popped open and juice spilled all over the floor.
example.cn: 盖子噗的一声弹开，果汁溅了一地。

enDef: a dark colour that is a mixture of red and blue

example.en: His face turned purple with rage.
example.cn: 他气得脸色发紫。

cn: 〔相对于业余爱好者而言的〕专业人士，职业人员〔尤指职业运动员〕
enDef: someone who is paid to do something, especially play a sport, that other people do for pleasure

example.en: a tennis pro
example.cn: 职业网球运动员

enDef: one side of a piece of paper in a book, newspaper, document etc, or the sheet of paper itself

example.en: The full address is given on page 15.
example.cn: 详细地址见第15页。

enDef: If a fact or idea pains you, it makes you feel upset and disappointed

example.en: This public acknowledgment of Ted's disability pained my mother.
example.cn: 特德残疾的公开使我母亲感到痛苦。

enDef: A planet is a large, round object in space that moves around a star. The Earth is a planet.

example.en: The picture shows six of the nine planets in the solar system.
example.cn: 这张图片展示太阳系9个行星中的6个行星。

enDef: a feeling that you are proud of something that you or someone connected with you has achieved

example.en: He wore his medals with pride.
example.cn: 他自豪地戴着奖章。

cn: 节目单； 节目， 表演， 演出； 计划， 方案； 程序
enDef: a set of instructions given to a computer to make it perform an operation

example.en: a word processing program
example.cn: 文字处理程序

cn: [put-put, putting] 放， 摆， 使处于； 说， 表达； 提出， 提交； 记下，
enDef: to say or write something using words in a particular way

example.en: So it was an accident, an ‘act of God’ if you want to put it like that .
example.cn: 那么这是个意外，是 上帝的作为”，如果你想那么说的话。

enDef: a small area of fresh water that is smaller than a lake, that is either natural or artificially made

example.en: The path descends to  the pond.
example.cn: 小路下斜通到池塘。

cn: 最初的， 最早的； 首要的， 根本的
enDef: most important

example.en: Our primary concern is to provide the refugees with food and health care.
example.cn: 我们的头等大事是向难民提供食品和医疗。

enDef: the official leader of a country that does not have a king or queen

example.en: President Bush
example.cn: 布什总统

enDef: letters, packages etc that are sent and delivered

example.en: Was there any post for me today?
example.cn: 今天有我的邮件吗？

enDef: a space or area, for example a particular point on a surface or in a room, building, town, city etc

example.en: Make sure you keep the key in a safe place.
example.cn: 一定要把钥匙放在安全的地方。

cn: 特定的， 某一的； 不寻常的， 特别的， 特有的； 讲究的， 挑剔的；
enDef: a particular thing or person is the one that you are talking about, and not any other

example.en: In this particular case, no one else was involved.
example.cn: 这件事没有其他人牵涉其中。

enDef: completely

example.en: I agree with you a hundred percent.
example.cn: 我百分之百同意你的看法。

cn: 要点； 观点； 点； 小数点； 时刻， 地点； 尖， 尖端； 分数， 得分
enDef: a single fact, idea, or opinion that is part of an argument or discussion

example.en: That’s a very interesting point.
example.cn: 那个观点很有趣。

enDef: to put a car or other vehicle in a particular place for a period of time

example.en: You can’t park here - it’s private property.
example.cn: 不能把车停在这里——这是私人宅邸。

cn: 游戏；扮演；演奏；播放；同…比赛
enDef: to perform a piece of music on a musical instrument

example.en: He’s learning to play the piano.
example.cn: 他在学习弹钢琴。

cn: 公众的；政府的；公用的；公立的
enDef: relating to all the ordinary people in a country, who are not members of the government or do not have important jobs

example.en: We have to show that publishing this story is in the public interest (= helpful or useful to ordinary people ) .
example.cn: 我们必须证明刊登这篇报道有利于公众。

cn: 小路， 小径； 路线， 途径， 路径
enDef: a track that has been made deliberately or made by many people walking over the same ground

example.en: I walked nervously up the garden path towards the front door.
example.cn: 我提心吊胆地沿着花园的小道向前门走去。

cn: 经过， 穿过； 传递， 传送； 度过； 通过； 批准
enDef: to come up to a particular place, person, or object and go past them

example.en: The crowd parted to let the truck pass.
example.cn: 人群分开让卡车通过。

cn: 以前的，过去的；结束了的，不复存在的
enDef: done, used, or experienced before now

example.en: Judging by her past performance, Jane should do very well.
example.cn: 从以往的表现来看，简应该会干得很好。

enDef: belonging or relating to one particular person, rather than to other people or to people in general

example.en: My personal view is that we shouldn’t offer him the job.
example.cn: 我个人认为我们不该给他这份工作。

enDef: a thin flat round cake made from flour, milk, and eggs, that has been cooked in a flat pan and is eaten hot

cn: 人口； 某领域的生物； 族群； 人口
enDef: the number of people living in a particular area, country etc

example.cn: 人口中差不多有70%仍住在乡村。

cn: 可能的， 做得到的； 可接受的， 合理的
enDef: if something is possible, it can be done or achieved

example.en: Is it possible toget tickets for the game?
example.cn: 有没有可能弄到比赛的门票？

cn: 允诺，答应；有…可能，有希望
enDef: to tell someone that you will definitely do or provide something or that something will happen

example.en: Last night the headmaster promised a full investigation.
example.cn: 校长昨晚允诺进行全面调查。

enDef: a small official document that you get from your government, that proves who you are, and which you need in order to leave your country and enter other countries

example.en: I have an Irish passport.
example.cn: 我持爱尔兰护照。

enDef: for use by one person or group, not for everyone

example.en: Morris has a private jet.
example.cn: 莫里斯拥有一架私人喷气式飞机。

enDef: used when saying that something may be true or likely, although you are not completely certain

example.en: This last task is possibly the most difficult.
example.cn: 这最后一项任务也许是最难的。

cn: 强烈打击， 猛击； 心怦怦跳； 费力地移动
enDef: to hit something very hard several times and make a lot of noise, damage it, break it into smaller pieces etc

example.en: He began pounding the keyboard of his computer.
example.cn: 他开始猛敲电脑键盘。

cn: 平的；简单的；朴素的；清晰的
enDef: in clear and simple words, without using technical language

example.en: The document, written in plain English, tells you about your new policy.
example.cn: 这份文件用简明的英语写成，解释了你们的新政策。

enDef: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it

example.en: He asked permission to leave the room.
example.cn: 他请求离开房间的许可。

enDef: a large black and white animal that looks like a bear and lives in the mountains of China

example.en: The caged panda chafed against the bars.
example.cn: 笼子里的大熊猫贴在栅栏上蹭它的身体。

enDef: the process of getting better at doing something, or getting closer to finishing or achieving something

example.en: We made good progress despite the snow.
example.cn: 尽管下雪，我们的行程还是很顺利。

enDef: a woman or child who is pretty has a nice attractive face

example.en: a pretty little girl
example.cn: 漂亮的小姑娘

cn: 积极的， 正面的； 肯定的； 【电】正的， 阳性的； 确实的， 明确的； 十足的，
enDef: good or useful

example.en: At least something positive has come out of the situation.
example.cn: 至少这个情况也产生了一些积极的东西。

cn: 适当的；本身的；特有的；正派的
enDef: right, suitable, or correct

example.en: Everything was in its proper place (= where it should be ) .
example.cn: 每样东西都放在恰当的位置。

cn: 舒适的； 令人愉快的； 讨人喜欢的
enDef: enjoyable or attractive and making you feel happy

example.en: It had been a pleasant evening.
example.cn: 那是个愉快的夜晚。

enDef: to give a judgment or opinion

example.en: The scheme was pronounced a failure.
example.cn: 该方案宣告失败。

cn: 对…施加压力； 迫使， 说服
enDef: to try to make someone do something by making them feel it is their duty to do it

example.en: He will never pressure you to get married.
example.cn: 他永远也不会给你施加压力让你结婚。

enDef: to carefully put something in a particular position

example.en: Position the cursor before the letter you want to delete.
example.cn: 把光标放在你想删去的字母之前。

cn: 塑料的；（外科）造型的；可塑的
enDef: made of plastic

example.en: a plastic spoon
example.cn: 塑料汤匙

enDef: to give something to someone, for example at a formal or official occasion

example.en: She was presented with an award .
example.cn: 她被授予一个奖项。

cn: 推动，增加；对…施加压力，逼迫；按；说服
enDef: to make someone or something move by pressing them with your hands, arms etc

example.en: It didn’t move, so she pushed harder.
example.cn: 它一动不动，因此她加力去推。

enDef: the way in which a language or a particular word is pronounced

example.en: She gave the word its French pronunciation.
example.cn: 她给出了这个单词的法语发音。

cn: 人， 人们； 人民， 民众， 平民； 国民； 民族
enDef: used as the plural of ‘person’ to refer to men, women, and children

example.en: How many people were at the meeting?
example.cn: 有多少人到会？

cn: 投射， 发射； 放映； 凸出， 伸出； 设计， 规划； 投射， 发射； 放映； 凸出， 伸出； 设计， 规划
enDef: to stick out beyond an edge or surface

example.en: projecting teeth
example.cn: 龅牙

enDef: an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a wooden stick with a thin piece of a black or coloured substance in the middle

example.en: a sharp pencil
example.cn: 尖尖的铅笔

enDef: a piece of writing that expresses emotions, experiences, and ideas, especially in short lines using words that  rhyme (= end with the same sound )

example.en: ...a book of love poems.
example.cn: …一本爱情诗集。

cn: 碟；金属板；金属牌；感光底片
enDef: a flat piece of metal with words or numbers on it, for example on a door or a car

example.en: The brass plate on the door said ‘Dr Rackman’.
example.cn: 黄铜门牌上写着“雷克曼博士”。

enDef: a way of doing something that has been officially agreed and chosen by a political party, a business, or another organization

example.en: an insurance policy
example.cn: 保险单

enDef: to decide the price of something that is for sale

example.en: a reasonably priced apartment
example.cn: 定价合理的公寓

cn: 包，包裹；套装软件，[计] 程序包

example.en: There’s a package here for a Miami Lakes address.
example.cn: 这里有一个寄往迈阿密湖的包裹。

enDef: to like someone or something more than someone or something else, so that you would choose it if you could

example.en: This type of owl prefers a desert habitat.
example.cn: 这种猫头鹰更喜欢沙漠的生活环境。

cn: 完美的， 无瑕的； 完全的， 十足的； 最佳的， 理想的
enDef: not having any mistakes, faults, or damage

example.en: His English was perfect.
example.cn: 他的英语很地道。

enDef: a farm animal with short legs, a fat body and a curved tail. Pigs are kept for their meat, which includes  pork  ,  bacon  and  ham  .

example.en: He kept pigs and poultry.
example.cn: 他养过猪和家禽。

enDef: peaceful and loving or wanting peace

example.en: a normally pacific community
example.cn: 平日里静悄悄的社区

cn: 惩罚；严厉对待；贪婪地吃喝
enDef: to make someone suffer because they have done something wrong or broken the law

example.en: Smacking is not an acceptable way of punishing a child.
example.cn: 要惩罚孩子，不应该用打的方式。

enDef: the official home of a person of very high rank, especially a king or queen – often used in names

example.en: Buckingham Palace
example.cn: 白金汉宫

enDef: used to say ‘sorry’ after you have made an impolite sound such as a  burp

example.en: Walter begged her pardon for all the pain he had caused her.
example.cn: 沃尔特请求她原谅自己给她造成那么多痛苦。

enDef: a long narrow area with walls on either side which connects one room or place to another

example.en: My office is just along the passage.
example.cn: 我的办公室就在过道旁边。

enDef: able to wait calmly for a long time or to accept difficulties, people’s annoying behaviour etc without becoming angry

example.en: You’ll just have to be patient and wait till I’m off the phone.
example.cn: 你只能耐心点，等我打完电话。

enDef: the meat from pigs

example.en: pork chops
example.cn: 猪排

cn: 或许；（表示不确定）也许；（用于粗略的估计）或许；（表示勉强同意或其实不赞成）也许；可能
enDef: used to say that something may be true, but you are not sure

example.en: Perhaps she’s next door.
example.cn: 她也许在隔壁。

enDef: a human being, especially considered as someone with their own particular character

example.en: He was a very nice person, always pleasant and friendly.
example.cn: 他是个很好的人，始终彬彬有礼。

enDef: the science concerned with the study of physical objects and substances, and of natural forces such as light, heat, and movement

example.en: ...the laws of physics.
example.cn: …物理学定律。

enDef: a large musical instrument that has a long row of black and white  key s  . You play the piano by sitting in front of it and pressing the keys.

example.en: Jean accompanied her on the piano .
example.cn: 琼为她钢琴伴奏。

enDef: to keep someone or something safe from harm, damage, or illness

example.en: Are we doing enough to protect the environment?
example.cn: 我们在保护环境方面做得够吗？

enDef: someone who operates the controls of an aircraft or spacecraft

example.en: an airline pilot
example.cn: 航空公司飞行员

enDef: something you have decided to do

example.en: His plan is to get a degree in economics and then work abroad for a year.
example.cn: 他计划先取得经济学学位，然后去国外工作一年。

enDef: a vehicle that flies in the air and has wings and at least one engine

example.en: It is a big airline with a large fleet of planes.
example.cn: 这是一家大航空公司，拥有庞大的机群。

enDef: an area for children to play, especially at a school or in a park, that often has special equipment for climbing on, riding on etc

example.en: children shouting and running in the playground
example.cn: 在操场上叫嚷奔跑的孩子们

cn: 贫困的， 贫穷的； 可怜的； 低劣的， 差的
enDef: not as good as it could be or should be

example.en: The soil in this area is very poor.
example.cn: 这一地区土壤很贫瘠。

cn: 池塘， 水池； 游泳池； 一摊， 一片
enDef: a hole or container that has been specially made and filled with water so that people can swim or play in it

example.en: They have a nice pool in their backyard.
example.cn: 他们后院有个漂亮的游泳池。

cn: 招贴， 海报， 广告
enDef: a large printed notice, picture, or photograph, used to advertise something or as a decoration

example.en: A team of volunteers were putting up posters .
example.cn: 一队志愿者正在张贴海报。

cn: [作物] 土豆，[作物] 马铃薯
enDef: a round white vegetable with a brown, red, or pale yellow skin, that grows under the ground

example.en: Marie stood at the sink, peeling potatoes (= cutting off the skin ) .
example.cn: 玛丽站在洗涤槽边削土豆皮。

enDef: when you do a particular thing, often regularly, in order to improve your skill at it

example.en: It takes hours of practice to learn to play the guitar.
example.cn: 学习弹吉他需要长时间的练习。

enDef: words that you say or write in order to praise someone or something

example.en: It’s important to give children plenty of praise and encouragement.
example.cn: 对小孩子多加表扬和鼓励是很重要的。

enDef: to stop something from happening, or stop someone from doing something

example.en: The rules are intended to prevent accidents.
example.cn: 这些规定旨在预防事故。

enDef: a photograph

example.en: Can you take a photo of me and Rachel?
example.cn: 你能给我和雷切尔拍张照吗？

enDef: a situation that causes difficulties

example.en: She was older than me, but that wasn’t really a problem.
example.cn: 她比我年长，不过那不算什么问题。

enDef: feeling pleased about something that you have done or something that you own, or about someone or something you are involved with or related to

example.en: Seth was the proud owner of a new sports car.
example.cn: 赛思因为有了新跑车而扬扬得意。

cn: 灌， 倒； 倾泻， 流出
enDef: to make a liquid or other substance flow out of or into a container by holding it at an angle

example.en: She poured coffee for everyone.
example.cn: 她为每个人都倒了咖啡。

enDef: a kind of corn that swells and bursts open when heated, and is usually eaten warm with salt or sugar as a  snack

example.en: Now, do you fancy some popcorn?
example.cn: 现在，你想来些爆米花吗？

cn: 地极的， 近地极的； 磁极的； 正好相反的， 截然对立的
enDef: close to or relating to the North Pole or the South Pole

example.en: As our climate warms up, the polar ice caps will begin to melt.
example.cn: 随着地球气候逐渐变暖，极地的冰冠将开始融化。

enDef: a word that is used instead of a noun or noun phrase, such as ‘he’ instead of ‘Peter’ or ‘the man’

example.en: Here you should use plural pronoun.
example.cn: 这里你应该用复数代词。

enDef: to say that something will happen, before it happens

example.en: Sales were five percent lower than predicted.
example.cn: 销售额比预期低5%。

enDef: showing that someone has been well trained and is good at their work

example.en: This business plan looks very professional.
example.cn: 这个商业计划看上去很有专业水平。

enDef: a British unit of money or coin used until 1971. There were 12 pennies in one  shilling

example.en: Unleaded petrol rose more than a penny a gallon.
example.cn: 无铅汽油每加仑涨了一个多便士。

enDef: to speak to someone by telephone

example.en: I’ll phone you this evening.
example.cn: 今晚我会给你打电话。

enDef: oats  that are cooked with milk or water and served hot for breakfast

example.en: We go for a run together in the morning then have porridge for breakfast.
example.cn: 早上起来我们会一起跑步，早餐一起吃麦片粥。

enDef: If you phrase something in a particular way, you express it in words in that way

example.en: I would have phrased it quite differently.
example.cn: 我则会用完全不同的话来表达它。

enDef: when something or someone is liked or supported by a lot of people

example.en: The president’s popularity has declined considerably.
example.cn: 总统的支持率大大下降了。

enDef: to be someone’s partner in a dance, game etc

example.en: I used to partner him in tennis matches.
example.cn: 我过去常在网球比赛中与他搭档。

enDef: a tropical bird with a curved beak and brightly coloured feathers that can be taught to copy human speech

example.en: We recited poems parrot fashion.
example.cn: 我们鹦鹉学舌般机械地背诵诗歌。

cn: 预言； 预料； 预报
enDef: a statement about what you think is going to happen, or the act of making this statement

example.en: The data can be used to make useful economic predictions .
example.cn: 这些数据可用于进行有用的经济预测。

example.en: Yes, first, and then to go to Paris.
example.cn: 是的，先是去结婚，然后还得到巴黎去一次。

enDef: one of the large areas into which some countries are divided, and which usually has its own local government

example.en: a Chinese province
example.cn: 中国的一个省

cn: 刺穿， 刺破， 穿透； 穿孔， 打眼
enDef: to make a small hole in or through something, using an object with a sharp point

example.en: Steam the corn until it can easily be pierced with a fork.
example.cn: 把玉米蒸到用叉子可以轻易扎透。

cn: 目的， 意图； 用途； 效果
enDef: the purpose of something is what it is intended to achieve

example.en: Nick had no particular purpose in mind when he started.
example.cn: 尼克开始的时候头脑中并没有明确的目标。

cn: 选手， 队员； 做游戏的人； 演员； 演奏者； 播
enDef: someone who takes part in a game or sport

example.en: a basketball player
example.cn: 篮球运动员

enDef: if you have a preference for something, you like it more than another thing and will choose it if you can

example.en: Do you have a colour preference ?
example.cn: 你有什么颜色上的偏好吗？

enDef: to have a particular quality or ability

example.en: Different workers possess different skills.
example.cn: 不同的工人拥有不同技能。

cn: 说服，劝说；使某人相信；劝某人做（不做）某事
enDef: to make someone decide to do something, especially by giving them reasons why they should do it, or asking them many times to do it

example.en: He was fairly easily persuaded .
example.cn: 他很轻易就被说服了。

cn: 粉；粉末；[化工][军] 火药；尘土
enDef: a dry substance in the form of very small grains

example.en: curry powder
example.cn: 咖喱粉

enDef: a short time during which someone stops speaking or doing something before starting again

example.en: There was a pause while Alice changed the tape.
example.cn: 艾丽斯换磁带的时候出现了短暂的停顿。

cn: 使…延期；把…放在次要地位；把…放在后面

example.en: The match had to be postponed until next week.
example.cn: 比赛不得不推迟到下周举行。

enDef: a scientist who has special knowledge and training in  physics

example.en: ...a nuclear physicist.
example.cn: …一位核物理学家。

enDef: a sudden strong feeling of fear or nervousness that makes you unable to think clearly or behave sensibly

example.en: a feeling of sheer panic
example.cn: 惊恐万分的感觉

enDef: to arrange for a book, magazine etc to be written, printed, and sold

example.en: The first edition was published in 1765.
example.cn: 第一版于1765年出版。

enDef: the study of the mind and how it influences people’s behaviour

example.en: the psychology of three-year-olds
example.cn: 三岁孩子的思想

enDef: to allow something to happen, especially by an official decision, rule, or law

example.en: Smoking is only permitted in the public lounge.
example.cn: 只允许在公共休息室里抽烟。

enDef: the people who work in a company, organization, or military force

example.en: All personnel are to receive security badges.
example.cn: 所有人员都将拿到安保徽章。

enDef: a group of several things of the same type that are put on top of each other

example.en: He balanced the plate on the top of a pile of books.
example.cn: 他把盘子在一摞书上放稳。

cn: 高兴的；喜欢的；乐意做某事
enDef: happy or satisfied

example.en: Your Dad will be so pleased.
example.cn: 你爸爸会非常高兴的。

enDef: a unit for measuring an amount of liquid, especially beer or milk. In Britain a pint is equal to 0.568 litres, and in the US it is equal to 0.473 litres.

example.en: He’s gone down the pub for a quick pint.
example.cn: 他去小酒馆匆匆喝上一品脱啤酒。

example.en: The method is applied in personalization information recommendation and achieves better effect.
example.cn: 将该方法用于个性化信息检索，取得较好的效果。

enDef: a  prime minister  – used in news reports

example.en: the Irish Premier
example.cn: 爱尔兰总理

enDef: to say that an action is illegal or not allowed

example.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the factory.
example.cn: 厂区严禁吸烟。

enDef: to speak to God in order to ask for help or give thanks

example.en: They went to the mosque to pray.
example.cn: 他们去清真寺祷告。

enDef: to fasten something somewhere, or to join two things together, using a pin

example.en: They pinned a notice to the door.
example.cn: 他们把通知钉在门上。

enDef: the money charged for sending a letter, package etc by post

example.en: How much is the postage for a postcard?
example.cn: 寄一张明信片的邮资是多少？

cn: 展示；描述，陈述；介绍；赠送
enDef: an event at which you describe or explain a new product or idea

example.en: We will begin a series of presentations to help the public fully understand our system.
example.cn: 我们将进行一系列的说明，帮助公众充分了解我们的制度。

enDef: if there is a possibility that something is true or that something will happen, it might be true or it might happen

example.en: There’s always a possibility that he might go back to Seattle.
example.cn: 他也许会回到西雅图去，这种可能性一直存在。

enDef: an amount expressed as if it is part of a total which is 100

example.en: Interest rates fell by six percentage points (= 6% ) .
example.cn: 利息下降了6个百分点。

cn: 步子， 步速； 节奏
enDef: the speed at which someone walks, runs, or moves

example.en: He quickened his pace , longing to be home.
example.cn: 他加快步伐，盼望着早点回到家中。

cn: 退休金，抚恤金；津贴；膳宿费
enDef: an amount of money paid regularly by the government or company to someone who does not work any more, for example because they have reached the age when people stop working or because they are ill

example.en: At what age can you start drawing your pension ?
example.cn: 从多少岁可以开始领取养老金？

cn: 促进； 提升； 推销
enDef: If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread

example.en: You don't have to sacrifice environmental protection to promote economic growth.
example.cn: 你们没有必要牺牲环保来促进经济增长。

enDef: something you buy, or the act of buying it

example.en: She paid for her purchases and left.
example.cn: 她付钱买好东西离开了。

enDef: to take part in an activity or event

example.en: Some members refused to participate.
example.cn: 有些会员拒绝参加。

enDef: words that you say when praying to God or gods

example.en: Our thoughts and prayers are with you at this difficult time.
example.cn: 在这艰难时期我们时刻思念你，为你祈祷。

cn: 擦亮， 磨光； 润色
enDef: to make something smooth, bright, and shiny by rubbing it

example.en: I spent all afternoon polishing the silver.
example.cn: 我整个下午都在擦拭银器。

enDef: the regular beat that can be felt, for example at your wrist, as your heart pumps blood around your body

example.en: His breathing was shallow and his pulse was weak .
example.cn: 他呼吸很浅，脉搏微弱。

enDef: a moral rule or belief about what is right and wrong, that influences how you behave

example.en: Schools try to teach children a set of principles.
example.cn: 学校设法教给孩子们一套道德准则。

enDef: a  plus sign

example.en: Daytime temperatures barely reached plus 5˚.
example.cn: 白天的气温仅零上5度。

enDef: A parallel is an imaginary line round the earth that is parallel to the equator. Parallels are shown on maps.

example.en: ...the area south of the 38th parallel.
example.cn: …38度纬线以南的地区。

enDef: a powder that is used to add a hot taste to food

example.en: salt and pepper
example.cn: 盐和胡椒粉

enDef: if a part of your body is painful, it hurts

example.en: stiff painful joints
example.cn: 僵硬疼痛的关节

cn: 亲自地；当面；个别地；就自己而言
enDef: if you do something personally, you do it yourself rather than getting someone else to do it

example.en: The managing director wrote personally to thank me.
example.cn: 总经理亲自写信向我表示感谢。

enDef: the act of parking a car or other vehicle

example.en: No Parking (= used on signs )
example.cn: 禁止停车

enDef: having a skin colour that is very white, or whiter than it usually is

example.en: He looked very pale and drawn.
example.cn: 他看上去非常苍白憔悴。

enDef: a small animal or insect that destroys crops or food supplies

example.en: a chemical used in pest control
example.cn: 用于防治虫害的一种化学品

enDef: work such as writing letters or reports, which must be done but is not very interesting

example.en: Police work involves so much paperwork these days.
example.cn: 如今当警察也要做这么多文书工作。

cn: 数据包，信息包；小包，小捆
enDef: a small flat package that is sent by post or delivered to someone

example.en: Paul tore open the packet as soon as it arrived.
example.cn: 保罗一收到包裹就拆开了。

enDef: continuing to exist for a long time or for all the time in the future

example.en: He gave up a permanent job in order to freelance.
example.cn: 他放弃了固定工作，为的是当一名自由职业者。

cn: 所有， 拥有； 财产， 所有物
enDef: if something is in your possession, you own it, or you have obtained it from somewhere

example.en: That information is not in our possession.
example.cn: 那则信息不归我们所有。

enDef: likely to develop into a particular type of person or thing in the future

example.en: The company has identified 60 potential customers.
example.cn: 该公司已确定了60位潜在的客户。

enDef: to move a small light boat through water, using one or more paddles

example.en: The dog was paddling furiously after the ducks.
example.cn: 那条狗在水里拼命划水追赶鸭子。

enDef: to make food, materials, or goods ready to be used or sold, for example by preserving or improving them in some way

example.en: Goats’ cheese may be processed in many ways.
example.cn: 山羊奶干酪可以有多种加工方法。

enDef: someone who writes poems

example.en: He was a painter and poet.
example.cn: 他是一位画家兼诗人。

enDef: someone who is walking, especially along a street or other place used by cars

example.en: Ingrid was a walker, even in Los Angeles, where a pedestrian is a rare sight.
example.cn: 英格丽德是个步行者，即使在行人少见的洛杉矶也是如此。

cn: 力量，能力；电力，功率；政权，势力；[数] 幂
enDef: the ability or right to control people or events

example.en: They seized power in a military coup.
example.cn: 他们在一场军事政变中夺取了政权。

enDef: the process of making or growing things to be sold, especially in large quantities

example.en: the new Shakespeare production at the Arts Theatre
example.cn: 艺术剧院新排演的莎士比亚戏剧

cn: 被动的，消极的；被动语态的
enDef: someone who is passive tends to accept things that happen to them or things that people say to them, without taking any action

example.en: Kathy seems to take a very passive role in the relationship.
example.cn: 凯茜在这一关系中似乎扮演着十分被动的角色。

enDef: precise information, details etc are exact, clear, and correct

example.en: precise sales figures
example.cn: 准确的销售数据

enDef: correctly, or in a way that is considered right

example.en: The brakes don’t seem to be working properly.
example.cn: 刹车似乎不正常。

cn: 部分地， 在一定程度上
enDef: to some degree, but not completely

example.en: The poor weather was partly responsible for the crash.
example.cn: 天气不好是造成坠机事故的部分原因。

enDef: an object that has been wrapped in paper or put in a special envelope, especially so that it can be sent by post

example.en: The parcel was delivered last week.
example.cn: 那个邮包上周送到了。

enDef: a liquid obtained from  petroleum  that is used to supply power to the engine of cars and other vehicles

example.en: unleaded petrol
example.cn: 无铅汽油

enDef: a doctor

example.en: ...your family physician.
example.cn: …你的家庭医生。

enDef: something that happens or exists in society, science, or nature, especially something that is studied because it is difficult to understand

example.en: Homelessness is not a new phenomenon .
example.cn: 无家可归已不是什么新现象。

enDef: a hard level surface or path at the side of a road for people to walk on

example.en: A small group of journalists waited on the pavement outside her house.
example.cn: 有一小群记者守候在她家外面的人行道上。

enDef: a teacher of the highest rank in a university department

example.en: Professor Barclay
example.cn: 巴克利教授

enDef: a special document that gives you the right to make or sell a new  invention  or product that no one else is allowed to copy

example.en: He wants to take out a patent on his new type of dustbin.
example.cn: 他想为他的新型垃圾桶取得专利。

cn: 身体的； 物理的； 客观存在的
enDef: related to someone’s body rather than their mind or emotions

example.en: She was in constant physical pain.
example.cn: 她一直感到身上疼痛。

enDef: to confuse someone or make them feel slightly anxious because they do not understand something

example.en: a question that continues to puzzle scientists
example.cn: 一直困扰科学家的问题

cn: 宝贵的；珍贵的；矫揉造作的
enDef: something that is precious is valuable and important and should not be wasted or used without care

example.en: planes delivering precious supplies of medicine and food
example.cn: 运送药品、食品等宝贵物资的飞机

enDef: a large stone building with four  triangular (= three-sided )  walls that slope in to a point at the top, especially in Egypt and Central America

example.en: different levels of the management pyramid
example.cn: 金字塔式管理体系中的不同层次

cn: 有毒的； 有害的； 致命的
enDef: containing poison or producing poison

example.en: Some mushrooms are extremely poisonous.
example.cn: 一些蘑菇有剧毒。

enDef: If you pine for something, you want it very much, especially when it is unlikely that you will be able to have it

example.en: I pine for the countryside.
example.cn: 我渴望乡下的生活。

enDef: someone who works in politics, especially an elected member of the government

example.en: politicians who are trying to get the minority vote
example.cn: 努力争取少数族群选票的政治家

enDef: someone who paints pictures

example.en: Gerry’s ambition was to become a portrait painter.
example.cn: 格里的志向是成为一名肖像画家。

cn: 准备， 预备； 准备工作， 准备措施
enDef: the process of preparing something or preparing for something

example.en: This dish is good for dinner parties because much of the preparation can be done ahead of time.
example.cn: 这道菜适合宴会，因为很多准备工作可以事先做好。

enDef: a job that needs a high level of education and training

example.en: people who work in the professions

example.cn: 小说开篇的几个段落

enDef: a peaceful time, place, or situation is quiet and calm without any worry or excitement

example.cn: 一个过路人描述了汽车炸弹爆炸后瞬间他所看到的情景。

enDef: relating to real situations and events rather than ideas, emotions etc

example.cn: 应征者应该具备基础电子学方面的培训和实践经验。

enDef: a chemical substance used to kill insects and small animals that destroy crops

example.en: They sprinkled pesticide to bug the potatoes .
example.cn: 他们喷撒杀虫剂给马铃薯除虫。

enDef: an un-reasonable dislike and distrust of people who are different from you in some way, especially because of their race, sex, religion etc – used to show disapproval

example.cn: 女性在职场中仍然面临歧视。

enDef: something that you watch on television or listen to on the radio

example.en: What’s your favourite television programme ?
example.cn: 你最喜欢的电视节目是什么？

enDef: Punishment is the act of punishing someone or of being punished

example.cn: …一个发起运动反对体罚儿童的组织。

example.cn: 他们把家具往后挪以便练习舞蹈动作。

enDef: someone who plays the piano

example.en: She was an accomplished pianist, a superb swimmer, and a gifted artist.
example.cn: 她曾是一位很有造诣的钢琴家、一流的游泳健将和天才艺术家。

cn: 港口，口岸；（计算机的）端口；左舷；舱门
enDef: a place where ships can be loaded and unloaded

example.en: Britain’s largest port
example.cn: 英国最大的港口城市

enDef: the raised place beside a railway track where you get on and off a train in a station

example.en: The Edinburgh train will depart from platform six.
example.cn: 开往爱丁堡的火车将从六号站台发车。

enDef: a painted picture that you put on a wall for people to see

example.en: a collection of valuable paintings
example.cn: 一批珍贵的画作

cn: 平底锅；盘状的器皿；淘盘子，金盘，秤盘

example.en: a frying pan
example.cn: 炒锅

example.en: We are trying to cut the price of prescription drugs .
example.cn: 我们正努力降低处方药的价格。

enDef: If you have patience, you are able to stay calm and not get annoyed, for example, when something takes a long time, or when someone is not doing what you want them to do

example.cn: 他没有耐心等。

enDef: a round green seed that is cooked and eaten as a vegetable, or the plant on which these seeds grow

example.en: roast chicken with peas and carrots
example.cn: 烤鸡配豌豆胡萝卜

cn: 桃子；桃树；桃红色；受人喜欢的人（或物）

example.cn: 安德顿射入一个好球。

enDef: during each hour etc

enDef: when someone performs a play or a piece of music

example.cn: 今晚的演出8点开始。

enDef: a cloth bag filled with soft material that you put your head on when you are sleeping

example.en: I’ll be asleep as soon as my head hits the pillow.

a tube through which a liquid or gas flows

example.cn: 对中国政治很好的了解

enDef: a box in a public place, into which you put letters that you want to send

example.cn: 我如此地肯定这件事的发生，当晚我写信给我的父母，把信投进了街角的邮箱。

enDef: a container for a plant, usually made of plastic or baked clay

example.cn: 长在花盆里的草本植物

example.cn: 印刷术的发明

example.cn: 起火的原因很可能是电路故障。

example.cn: 保护费

enDef: in a way that is intended for anyone to know, see, or hear

example.cn: 寂静间或被笑声打破。

example.cn: “吃饭？”萨姆问道，看上去很迷惑。

enDef: an action or event that makes someone angry or upset, or is intended to do this

example.en: He was accused of deliberate provocation .
example.cn: 他被指责故意挑衅。

enDef: intended to stop something you do not want to happen, such as illness, from happening

example.en: preventive health programs
example.cn: 预防性的保健计划

enDef: showing or involving very strong feelings of sexual love

example.cn: 他和一个比他年长的女子有过一段短暂而炽热的情史。

enDef: a very strong belief or feeling about something

example.en: The issue arouses strong passions .
example.cn: 那件事激起了人们强烈的情绪。

example.en: The teacher told him to weigh this matter patiently.
example.cn: 老师让他耐心考虑这事。

enDef: your peers are the people who are the same age as you, or who have the same type of job, social class etc

example.cn: 美国儿童的数学成绩不如日本的同龄儿童。

enDef: to notice, see, or recognize something

example.cn: 那天早上，他注意到弗兰卡情绪的变化。

example.cn: 她得到了经理的职位，不懈坚持终于有了回报。

example.cn: 尽管个性不同，他们还是成了最好的朋友。

enDef: a way of thinking about something, especially one which is influenced by the type of person you are or by your experiences

example.cn: 那位画家对透视法的运用

enDef: the act of persuading someone to do something

example.en: After a little gentle persuasion , Debbie agreed to let us in.
example.cn: 好言劝说了几句后，黛比就同意让我们进去了。

enDef: someone who is picky only likes particular things and not others, and so is not easy to please

example.en: He’s a very picky eater .
example.cn: 他很挑食。

enDef: a serious promise or agree-ment, especially one made publicly or officially

example.en: The meeting ended with a pledge to step up cooperation between the six states of the region.
example.cn: 会议以加快该地区6个州之间合作的承诺结束。

enDef: the process of finding out what people think about something by asking many people the same question, or the record of the result

example.cn: 最近的一项民意调查发现80%的加利福尼亚人支持州长。

enDef: to sit or stand in a particular position in order to be photographed or painted, or to make someone do this

example.cn: 安摆好姿势露出笑脸准备拍照。

example.cn: 他说，“考虑到在法律行业的竞争水平，我确实认为我的研究生学位让我从众人中脱颖而出”。

enDef: when something is kept in its original state or in good condition

example.en: methods of food preservation
example.cn: 保存食物的各种方法

enDef: if a belief, custom, situation etc prevails, it exists among a group of people at a certain time

example.cn: 同样的情况在加拿大也普遍存在。

enDef: Preventable diseases, illnesses, or deaths could be stopped from occurring

example.cn: 每天有四万儿童死于本可以防止的疾病。

example.cn: 圭亚那的铁路先前为私营公司所拥有。

enDef: mainly

example.en: The advertisement is aimed primarily at children.
example.cn: 这则广告的对象主要是儿童。

enDef: the thing that you think is most important and that needs attention before anything else

example.cn: 该俱乐部首先考虑的是要赢得联赛。

enDef: the state of being free from public attention

example.en: each individual’s right to privacy
example.cn: 每个人的隐私权

enDef: producing or achieving a lot

example.cn: 我们大多数人在早上更有效率。

enDef: producing a profit or a useful result

example.en: The advertising campaign proved very profitable.
example.cn: 事实证明，这次广告宣传活动卓有成效。

enDef: having a strong influence or effect

example.en: a profound sense of guilt
example.cn: 强烈的内疚感

enDef: the activity of writing programs for computers, or something written by a programmer

example.en: a course in computer programming
example.cn: 计算机编程的课程

enDef: important

example.en: a prominent Russian scientist
example.cn: 杰出的俄罗斯科学家

enDef: showing signs of being successful or good in the future

example.en: a promising career in law
example.cn: 很有前途的法律职业

example.en: Prompt action must be taken.
example.cn: 必须立即采取行动。

enDef: A proportion of a group or an amount is a part of it

example.en: A large proportion of the dolphins in that area will eventually die.
example.cn: 那个地区的很大一部分海豚最终都会死去。

enDef: a particular event which will probably or definitely happen in the future – used especially when you want to talk about how you feel about it

example.en: I had no job, no education, and no prospects .
example.cn: 我没有工作，没受过什么教育，前途渺茫。

enDef: to cause a reaction or feeling, especially a sudden one

example.en: The novel has provoked fierce debate in the US.
example.cn: 那部小说在美国引发了激烈的争论。

enDef: relating to the way that your mind works and the way that this affects your behaviour

example.en: Sleep disorders are a serious psychological problem .
example.cn: 睡眠障碍是严重的心理疾病。

enDef: to give information about something to the public, so that they know about it

example.cn: 电视未能报道失业问题

enDef: to continue doing an activity or trying to achieve something over a long period of time

example.en: She plans to pursue a career in politics.
example.cn: 她计划从政。

enDef: if something or someone is predictable, you know what will happen or what they will do – sometimes used to show disapproval

example.en: The snow had a predictable effect on traffic.
example.cn: 这场雪对交通造成的影响可以预见。

enDef: a side view of someone’s head

example.en: Dani has a lovely profile.
example.cn: 达尼的侧面轮廓很好看。

cn: 多重性； 兼职， 兼任

example.en: a nation characterized by cultural pluralism
example.cn: 以多元文化为特色的国家

enDef: someone who is specially trained to perform religious duties and ceremonies in the Christian church

example.en: He had trained to be a Catholic priest.
example.cn: 他接受培训成了一名天主教神父。

enDef: someone who is trained in psychology

example.en: a clinical psychologist
example.cn: 临床心理学家

enDef: Perception is the recognition of things using your senses, especially the sense of sight

example.en: And when they do, what do you think their perception will be?
example.cn: 当他们这样做时，你觉得他们的知觉是怎样的？

cn: 大概， 可能， 据推测

example.cn: 下雨了，这可能意味着你们的足球比赛要取消。

enDef: confusing and difficult to understand or explain

example.en: a puzzling fact
example.cn: 令人费解的情况

enDef: continuing to exist or happen, especially for longer than is usual or desirable

example.en: persistent rumours
example.cn: 持续流传的谣言

enDef: when people have money and everything that is needed for a good life

example.en: a time of economic prosperity
example.cn: 经济繁荣时期

enDef: a situation that seems strange because it involves two ideas or qualities that are very different

example.cn: 在如此富有的国家却有这么多的贫穷现象，真是矛盾。

enDef: a very small piece of something

example.en: dust particles
example.cn: 尘埃

enDef: worthless or not likely to have any useful result

example.en: Life just seemed pointless to me.
example.cn: 生活对我来说简直没什么意义。

enDef: a plan or suggestion which is made formally to an official person or group, or the act of making it

example.cn: 总统将提出解决国家宪法危机的新议案。

example.cn: 根据一家公司促销材料上所说的，“牛仔裤为耐穿而设计和制作。”

enDef: to cause pain, suffering, or trouble to someone, especially for a long period of time

example.en: Financial problems continued to plague the company.
example.cn: 资金问题持续困扰着该公司。

example.en: Heterosexuals should not be treated preferentially when the state carries out that role.
example.cn: 当国家执行这个作用的时候不应该优先对待异性恋者。

enDef: a punishment for breaking a law, rule, or legal agreement

example.en: No littering. Penalty $500.
example.cn: 禁止乱扔垃圾。 违者罚款500美元。

example.cn: “我不明白为什么我要对此承担责任！”她抗议道。

example.en: The computer programmer botched (up) the job and had to start over.
example.cn: 计算机程序设计员把文件弄坏了，只好重做。

enDef: someone who studies and develops ideas about the nature and meaning of existence, truth, good and evil etc

example.en: Plato, Aristotle, and other Greek philosophers
example.cn: 柏拉图、亚里士多德和其他希腊哲学家

enDef: to deliberately make something such as a feeling or an activity last longer

example.en: I was trying to think of some way to prolong the conversation.
example.cn: 我在想方设法拖长这次谈话。

cn: 公众的注意， 名声； 宣传， 宣扬
enDef: Publicity is information or actions that are intended to attract the public's attention to someone or something

example.en: Much advance publicity was given to the talks.
example.cn: 会谈之前做了大量的宣传。

cn: 劝诱的； 有说服力的
enDef: able to make other people believe something or do what you ask

example.en: Trevor can be very persuasive.
example.cn: 特雷弗有时很会说服人。

cn: 礼仪， 礼节； 草案， 议定书
enDef: a system of rules about the correct way to behave on an official occasion

example.en: a breach of diplomatic protocol
example.cn: 违反外交礼节

enDef: to make a difficult subject or idea able to be easily understood by ordinary people who have no special knowledge about it

example.en: Skinner was the psychologist who popularized behavior modification.
example.cn: 斯金纳就是那位使行为矫正概念得到普及的心理学家。

cn: 长裤， 便裤； 内裤
enDef: a piece of clothing that covers you from your waist to your feet and has a separate part for each leg

example.en: She was wearing dark blue pants and a white sweater.
example.cn: 她穿着深蓝色长裤和白色毛衣。

enDef: a thick flat object made of cloth or rubber, used to protect or clean something, or to make something more comfortable

example.en: Use an abrasive pad for stubborn stains.
example.cn: 用百洁布擦洗顽固污渍。

enDef: the inside surface of your hand, in which you hold things

example.en: He held the pebble in the palm of his hand .
example.cn: 他把那颗卵石握在手心里。

enDef: a board in a car, plane, boat etc that has the controls on it

example.en: He assembled a panel of scholars to advise him.
example.cn: 他集结了一个学者小组为他出谋划策。

enDef: a public celebration when musical bands, brightly decorated vehicles etc move down the street

example.en: a victory parade
example.cn: 胜利游行

enDef: the group of people who are elected to make a country’s laws and discuss important national affairs

example.en: They demanded a free parliament and press.
example.cn: 他们要求议会自由和新闻自由。

enDef: not complete

example.en: The exhibition was only a partial success.
example.cn: 那次展会只获得部分成功。

enDef: more than usual or more than others

example.en: Steve was in a particularly bad mood when he got back.
example.cn: 史蒂夫回来时情绪特别不好。

enDef: a soft thick mixture that can easily be shaped or spread

example.en: Mix the powder with enough water to make a smooth paste.
example.cn: 把粉末和足够的水混合调成均匀的糊状。

enDef: to lightly touch someone or something several times with your hand flat, especially to give comfort

example.en: He patted the dog affectionately.
example.cn: 他亲热地轻轻拍了拍那只狗。

enDef: a small piece of material that is sewn on something to cover a hole in it

example.en: a jacket with leather patches at the elbows
example.cn: 肘部有皮革补丁的短上衣

example.en: This month alone, my wife and I spent $600 on one Labrador retriever with a bladder infection who needed some kidney tests and $300 on the other one for an injured paw.
example.cn: 仅这个月，我和我妻子就为一患膀胱感染而需要肾测试的拉布拉多犬花费了600美元，同时为另外一只爪子受伤的拉布拉多犬支付了300美元。

enDef: an amount of money that has been or must be paid

example.en: You can make a payment in any bank.
example.cn: 你可以在任何一家银行付款。

enDef: the sharply pointed top of a mountain

example.en: snow-capped mountain peaks
example.cn: 白雪覆盖的山顶

enDef: behaving in a strange and slightly crazy way

example.en: He’s been a little peculiar lately.
example.cn: 最近他有点怪异。

enDef: to enter something and pass or spread through it, especially when this is difficult

example.en: bullets that penetrate thick armour plating
example.cn: 穿过厚装甲的子弹

enDef: to continue to do something, although this is difficult, or other people oppose it

example.en: ‘I don’t think it’s right,’ John persisted.
example.cn: “我认为那不对。”约翰坚持说道。

enDef: expecting that bad things will happen in the future or that something will have a bad result

example.en: a pessimistic view of life
example.cn: 对人生的悲观看法

enDef: oil that is obtained from below the surface of the Earth and is used to make petrol,  paraffin  , and various chemical substances

example.en: petroleum-based products
example.cn: 石油产品

enDef: one of the stages of a process of development or change

example.en: a new drug that is in the experimental phase
example.cn: 处于试验阶段的一种新药

enDef: the study of the nature and meaning of existence, truth, good and evil, etc

example.en: Emma studies philosophy at university.
example.cn: 埃玛在大学攻读哲学。

enDef: a grey bird with short legs that is common in cities

example.en: Many journalists here choose to pigeon all but the most innocuous of stories.
example.cn: 除了平淡乏味的报道，这儿的新闻记者将一切通过鸽子传递出去。

enDef: somebody who is an important and respected member of a group, and is involved in many public activities

example.en: Mr Fitzwilliam had been seen as a pillar of the community.
example.cn: 菲茨威廉先生已被视为社区的骨干。

enDef: to press a part of someone’s skin very tightly between your finger and thumb, especially so that it hurts

example.en: We have to stop her pinching her baby brother.
example.cn: 我们不能让她再掐她小弟弟了。

enDef: a coal mine

example.en: Dad first went down the pit (= worked in a coal mine ) when he was 15 years old.
example.cn: 爸爸第一次下煤矿井时才15岁。

enDef: a black, sticky substance that is used on roofs, the bottoms of ships etc to stop water coming through

example.en: The night was as black as pitch (= very dark ) .
example.cn: 夜晚一片漆黑。

enDef: a large area of land in a hot country, where crops such as tea, cotton, and sugar are grown

example.en: a rubber plantation
example.cn: 橡胶园

enDef: more than enough in quantity

example.en: a plentiful supply of food
example.cn: 食物的大量供应

enDef: a piece of farm equipment used to turn over the earth so that seeds can be planted

example.en: There are new tractors and new ploughs in the machinery lot.
example.cn: 机器设备场里有新拖拉机和新耕犁。

enDef: If a person or thing is plunged into a particular state or situation, or if they plunge into it, they are suddenly in that state or situation

example.en: The government's political and economic reforms threaten to plunge the country into chaos.
example.cn: 该政府的政治和经济改革有可能使这个国家陷入混乱之中。

enDef: a plural word or form shows you are talking about more than one thing, person etc. For example, ‘we’ is a plural  pronoun  .

example.en: "Data" is the Latin plural form of "datum."
example.cn: “”是“”的拉丁语复数形式。

enDef: poems in general, or the art of writing them

example.en: He reads a lot of poetry.
example.cn: 他大量阅读诗歌。

enDef: a part of something larger, especially a part that is different from the other parts

example.en: Do you have any children’s portions?
example.cn: 你们有儿童餐吗？

enDef: a painting, drawing, or photograph of a person

example.en: a family portrait
example.cn: 全家福

enDef: the situation or experience of being poor

example.en: Millions of elderly people live in poverty .
example.cn: 数百万老年人生活在贫困之中。

enDef: almost

example.en: I’ve read practically all of his books.
example.cn: 我差不多读过他所有的书。

enDef: something you do in order to prevent something dangerous or unpleasant from happening

example.en: Fire precautions were neglected.
example.cn: 防火措施被忽视了。

enDef: happening or coming before the time, place, or part mentioned

example.en: As we saw in the preceding chapter, groups can be powerful agents of socialization.
example.cn: 如我们在前一章所见，团组可以是社会化的有力动因。

enDef: the quality of being very exact or correct
an introduction at the beginning of a book or speech

example.en: ...the preface to Kelman's novel.
example.cn: …凯尔曼小说的前言。

enDef: better or more suitable

example.en: For this dish, fresh herbs and garlic are preferable.
example.cn: 做这道菜，用新鲜香草和大蒜更好。

enDef: happening before something that is more important, often in order to prepare for it

example.en: the preliminary stages of the competition
example.cn: 竞赛的预赛阶段

enDef: a word that is used before a noun,  pronoun  , or  gerund  to show place, time, direction etc. In the phrase ‘the trees in the park’, ‘in’ is a preposition.

example.en: There is nothing in the rules of grammar to suggest that ending a sentence with a preposition is wrong.
example.cn: 在语法规则中没有哪一条表明以介词结束一个句子是错误的。

example.en: The physician examines the patient then diagnoses the disease and prescribes medication.
example.cn: 内科医生检查了病人，然后对疾病作出诊断，并开出药方。

enDef: when someone or something is present in a particular place

example.en: Your presence is requested at the club meeting on Friday.
example.cn: 敬请出席于周五举行的俱乐部会议。

enDef: in a short time

example.en: The doctor will be here presently.
example.cn: 医生一会儿就到。

enDef: most important

example.en: Smoking is the prime cause of lung disease.
example.cn: 抽烟是引发肺部疾病的首要原因。

enDef: the son of a king, queen, or prince

example.en: Prince William
example.cn: 威廉王子

enDef: a close female relation of a king and queen, especially a daughter

example.en: Princess Anne
example.cn: 安妮公主

enDef: most important

example.en: His principal reason for making the journey was to visit his family.
example.cn: 他那次旅程的首要目的是探访家人。

enDef: existing or arranged before something else or before the present situation

example.en: You do not need any prior knowledge of the subject.
example.cn: 你无需事先具备该方面的知识。

enDef: how likely something is, sometimes calculated in a mathematical way

example.en: You must decide whether, on the balance of probabilities , he committed the crime.
example.cn: 你们一定要权衡正反两方面的可能性，然后再裁定他是否犯罪。

enDef: to continue to do something that has already been planned or started

example.en: Before proceeding further, we must define our terms.
example.cn: 我们必须先定义术语，然后再往下展开。

enDef: a line of people or vehicles moving slowly as part of a ceremony

example.en: They marched in procession to the Capitol building.
example.cn: 他们列队向国会大厦行进。

enDef: supporting new or modern ideas and methods, especially in politics and education

example.en: a progressive administration
example.cn: 进步的政府

enDef: facts, information, documents etc that prove something is true

example.en: There is no proof that the document is authentic.
example.cn: 没有证据证明这份文件是真的。

enDef: the thing or things that someone owns

example.en: The hotel is not responsible for any loss or damage to guests’ personal property .
example.cn: 宾馆对住客个人财物的丢失和损坏概不负责。

enDef: something that is proportional to something else is in the correct or most suitable relationship to it in size, amount, importance etc

example.en: The fee charged by the realtor is directly proportional to the price of the property.
example.cn: 房产代理人收取的费用和房产价格是成正比的。

enDef: to suggest something as a plan or course of action

example.en: the changes currently proposed by the local planning authorities
example.cn: 目前由地方规划局提议的改革

enDef: rich and successful

example.en: a prosperous landowner
example.cn: 富裕的土地拥有者

enDef: used or intended for protection

example.en: protective clothing
example.cn: 防护服

enDef: one of several natural substances that exist in food such as meat, eggs, and beans, and which your body needs in order to grow and remain strong and healthy

example.en: Where do you get your protein?
example.cn: 你从哪里获得蛋白质？

enDef: when you provide something that someone needs now or in the future

example.en: He made provisions for his wife and his children in his will.
example.cn: 在遗嘱里他为妻子和孩子都做好了安排。

enDef: The publication of a book or magazine is the act of printing it and sending it to stores to be sold

example.en: The guide is being translated into several languages for publication near Christmas.
example.cn: 这本指南正被翻译成好几种语言，准备在圣诞节前后出版。

enDef: to criticize someone’s views, idea, plans etc by showing why they are wrong

example.en: This new sort of punch could stamp out 3,000 bonnets an hour.
example.cn: 这种新型冲床每小时可冲压出三千个汽车引擎盖。

cn: 似有道理的， 似乎正确的， 貌似可信的
enDef: reasonable and likely to be true or successful

example.en: His story certainly sounds plausible.
example.cn: 他的叙述听上去当然很合理。

cn: 挑衅的， 煽动的， 刺激的； 挑逗的
enDef: provocative behaviour, remarks etc are intended to make people angry or upset, or to cause a lot of discussion

example.en: a provocative act by a terrorist group
example.cn: 恐怖团体的挑衅行为

enDef: mainly

example.en: The money is principally invested in stocks and shares.
example.cn: 这笔钱主要投资于股票。

cn: 摆出姿势， 装模作样
enDef: You can say that someone is posturing when you disapprove of their behaviour because you think they are trying to give a particular impression in order to deceive people

example.en: She says the president may just be posturing.
example.cn: 她说总统也许只是在作态。

enDef: to be in charge of a formal event, organization, ceremony etc

example.en: I shall be pleased to preside at your meetings.
example.cn: 我很高兴主持你们的会议。

enDef: happening a number of times, usually at regular times

example.en: periodic home visits by nurses
example.cn: 护士的定期上门探访

enDef: in the outer area of something, or relating to this area

example.en: the city’s peripheral suburbs
example.cn: 这座城市的市郊

enDef: the border around an enclosed area such as a military camp

example.en: ...the perimeter of the airport.
example.cn: …机场周边。

enDef: a very small piece of matter with a positive electrical  charge  that is in the central part of an atom

example.en: When a neutron inside an atom decays, it produces a proton, an electron, and a neutrino.
example.cn: 原子内的一个中子衰变后会产生一个质子、一个电子和一个中微子。

enDef: allowed by law or by the rules

example.en: the maximum permissible level of radiation
example.cn: 允许的最大辐射水平

enDef: more powerful, more common, or more easily noticed than others

example.en: the predominant group in society
example.cn: 社会中的主导群体

enDef: a short piece of wood, metal, or plastic that is attached to a wall or fits into a hole, used especially to hang things on or to fasten things together

example.en: Sarah hung her coat on the peg.
example.cn: 萨拉把外套挂在衣钩上。

enDef: the first form that a new design of a car, machine etc has, or a model of it used to test the design before it is produced

example.en: the prototype of the modern bicycle
example.cn: 现代自行车的雏形

enDef: a man who people in the Christian, Jewish, or Muslim religion believe has been sent by God to lead them and teach them their religion

example.en: the prophet Elijah
example.cn: 先知以利亚

enDef: a statement that something will happen in the future, especially one made by someone with religious or magic powers

example.en: the prophecy of Isaiah
example.cn: 以赛亚的预言

enDef: to set the controls of a piece of electrical equipment so that it will start to work at a particular time

example.en: ...a computerized timer that can be preset.
example.cn: ...一个可以预调的电脑定时器。

enDef: when something bad is stopped from happening

example.en: a fire prevention officer
example.cn: 消防官员

cn: 油酥面团， 酥皮糕点
enDef: a mixture of flour, butter, and milk or water, used to make the outer part of baked foods such as  pie s

example.en: a Danish pastry
example.cn: 丹麦油酥糕饼

enDef: relating to the official system which takes letters from one place to another

example.en: the U.S. postal service
example.cn: 美国邮政

enDef: a book with a stiff paper cover

example.en: a shelf full of paperbacks
example.cn: 放满了平装书的书架

enDef: to suggest that something might have happened or be true

example.en: He dismissed arguments postulating differing standards for human rights in different cultures and regions.
example.cn: 他无法接受的是假定人权标准在不同文化和地区有所不同。

enDef: a short well-known statement that gives advice or expresses something that is generally true. ‘A penny saved is a penny earned’ is an example of a proverb.

example.en: An old Arab proverb says, "The enemy of my enemy is my friend."
example.cn: 有一句古老的阿拉伯谚语说：“我敌人的敌人是我的朋友。”

cn: 契约， 协定， 条约
enDef: a formal agreement between two groups, countries, or people, especially to help each other or to stop fighting

example.en: the Warsaw pact
example.cn: 华沙条约

enDef: a thick cold sauce that is made from pieces of vegetables preserved in vinegar. It is usually eaten with cold meat or cheese

example.en: cheese and pickle sandwiches
example.cn: 干酪腌菜三明治

enDef: when someone goes around different parts of an area at regular times to check that there is no trouble or danger

example.en: The security forces increased their patrols in the area.
example.cn: 安全部队加强了对该地区的巡逻。

enDef: a substance that makes air, water, soil etc dangerously dirty, and is caused by cars, factories etc

example.en: a dumping ground for toxic pollutants
example.cn: 有毒污染物堆放场

enDef: information which is false or which emphasizes just one part of a situation, used by a government or political group to make people agree with them

example.en: the spreading of political propaganda
example.cn: 政治宣传的开展

enDef: a young dog

example.en: a six-month-old puppy
example.cn: 一只六个月大的小狗

enDef: a very thin book with paper covers, that gives information about something

example.en: a political pamphlet
example.cn: 政治宣传册

enDef: a religious person who travels a long way to a holy place

example.en: pilgrims visiting a holy shrine
example.cn: 祭拜圣庙的朝圣者

enDef: something that you do because you think it is enjoyable or interesting

example.en: Reading was her favourite pastime.
example.cn: 阅读是她最喜爱的消遣方式。

enDef: to charge someone with a crime and try to show that they are guilty of it in a court of law

example.en: Shoplifters will be prosecuted.
example.cn: 在商店行窃者将被起诉。

enDef: nearness in distance or time

example.en: Here the rich and the poor live in close proximity (= very near to each other ) .
example.cn: 在这里，富人和穷人比邻而居。

enDef: to foreordain; determine beforehand
to happen or exist before something or someone, or to come before something else in a series

example.en: a type of cloud that precedes rain
example.cn: 下雨前出现的一种云

enDef: small and unimportant

example.en: petty squabbles
example.cn: 小口角

enDef: in relation to your body rather than your mind or emotions

example.en: She is young and physically fit.
example.cn: 她年轻而且身体健康。

cn: 房屋和地基， 经营场址； 前提， 假设
enDef: the buildings and land that a shop, restaurant, company etc uses

example.en: Schools may earn extra money by renting out their premises.
example.cn: 学校通过出租房屋场地可以获取额外收入。

enDef: a false reason given for an action, in order to hide the real reason

example.en: He’ll phone on some pretext or other.
example.cn: 他会以这样或那样的理由打电话的。

enDef: to argue in support of sb/sth

example.en: He appeared before the committee to plead his case.
example.cn: 他出现在委员会上为他的案子辩护。

enDef: great danger, especially of being harmed or killed

example.en: a voyage that was fraught with peril
example.cn: 历尽艰险的旅程

enDef: in some religions, a perfect place where people are believed to go after they die, if they have led good lives

example.en: The Koran describes paradise as a place containing a garden of delight.
example.cn: 《古兰经》把天堂描绘成一个拥有快乐花园的地方。

example.en: You can bet that would truly paralyze the flow of credit: Does anyone believe Washington can manage banks?
example.cn: 你可以打赌，这会使流动的信贷真正限于瘫痪：真有人相信华盛顿可以经营银行吗？

enDef: land or a field that is covered with grass and is used for cattle, sheep etc to feed on

example.en: large areas of rough upland pasture
example.cn: 大片起伏的山地牧场

enDef: to cover a path, road, area etc with a hard level surface such as blocks of stone or  concrete

example.en: a paved courtyard
example.cn: 地面铺砌过的院子

enDef: the total amount of wages paid to all the people working in a particular company or industry

example.en: the annual payroll was $88 million
example.cn: 年度工资总支出为8,800万美元

enDef: to die, especially in a terrible or sudden way

example.en: Hundreds perished when the ship went down.
example.cn: 轮船沉没，数百人罹难。

enDef: someone who always expects that bad things will happen

example.en: Don’t be such a pessimist!
example.cn: 别这么悲观！

enDef: the force that drives a vehicle forward

example.en: research into liquid hydrogen as a means of propulsion
example.cn: 对液态氢作为一种动力方式进行的研究

enDef: to move, drive, or push something forward

example.en: a boat propelled by a small motor
example.cn: 由小马达驱动的小船

enDef: to spend time thinking carefully and seriously about a problem, a difficult question, or something that has happened

example.en: He continued to ponder the problem as he walked home.
example.cn: 他一边往家走一边继续思考那个问题。

enDef: something that is potentially dangerous, useful etc is not dangerous etc now, but may become so in the future

example.en: a potentially dangerous situation
example.cn: 有潜在危险的局势

enDef: an action or official decision that can be used to give support to later actions or decisions

example.en: a legal precedent
example.cn: 判例

enDef: a piece of equipment that makes a film or picture appear on a screen or flat surface

example.en: ...a slide projector.
example.cn: …幻灯机。

enDef: You use predominantly to indicate which feature or quality is most noticeable in a situation

example.en: The landscape has remained predominantly rural in appearance.
example.cn: 该风景看上去主要保留了乡村风貌。

example.en: Am I suggesting that we should return to the preindustrial mode of production or to nineteenth-century "free enterprise" capitalism?
example.cn: 我是否在建议我们应回到工业化前的生产模式或回到十九世纪"自由企业"资本主义时期呢？

enDef: an entrance covered by a roof outside the front door of a house or church

example.en: He was standing on the porch, waving as we drove away.
example.cn: 我们开车离开的时候，他站在走廊上向我们挥手。

enDef: the position of being the president of a country or organization, or the period of time during which someone is president

example.en: Roosevelt was elected four times to the presidency of the US.
example.cn: 罗斯福四次当选美国总统。

enDef: the respect and admiration that someone or something gets because of their success or important position in society

example.en: The king wanted to enhance his prestige through war.
example.cn: 国王想通过战争来提高自己的威信。

cn: 无价的，难以用价格衡量的
enDef: extremely valuable

example.en: priceless antiques
example.cn: 极其贵重的古董

enDef: the rate at which goods are produced, and the amount produced, especially in relation to the work, time, and money needed to produce them

example.en: high productivity levels in manufacturing
example.cn: 制造业中的高生产率

enDef: continuing for a long time

example.en: prolonged exposure to the sun
example.cn: 长时间暴露在阳光下

example.en: a large, placid baby
example.cn: 一个胖胖的、安静的婴儿

cn: 剽窃，抄袭（别人学说、著作）
enDef: to take words or ideas from another person’s work and use them in your work, without stating that they are not your own

example.en: He accused other scientists of plagiarizing his research.
example.cn: 他指控其他科学家剽窃他的研究成果。

enDef: a plaintive sound is high, like someone crying, and sounds sad

example.en: They lay on the firm sands, listening to the plaintive cry of the seagulls.
example.cn: 他们躺在坚实的沙滩上，听着海鸥的哀鸣。

enDef: a building where lights on a curved ceiling show the movements of planets and stars

example.en: The motions of the stars can be approximated in a planetarium.
example.cn: 星星的运动可在天文馆里模拟。

enDef: a long narrow piece of wooden board, used especially for making structures to walk on

example.en: a long plank of wood
example.cn: 一长条厚木板

enDef: the very small forms of plant and animal life that live in water, especially the sea, and are eaten by fish

example.en: ...its usual diet of plankton and other small organisms.
example.cn: ...它通常赖以为食的浮游生物和其他微生物。

enDef: a statement that has been made many times before and is not interesting or clever – used to show disapproval

example.en: His excuse was the platitude ‘boys will be boys.’
example.cn: 他还是那一套理由:“男孩总归是男孩。”

cn: 易弯的，柔韧的；易受影响的
enDef: able to bend without breaking or cracking

example.en: a shoe made of soft pliable leather
example.cn: 柔韧的皮革做成的鞋子

enDef: if an event is a prelude to a more important event, it happens just before it and makes people expect it

example.en: Living together as a prelude to marriage is now considered acceptable in many countries.
example.cn: 婚前同居如今在许多国家都已被接受。

enDef: a right that someone has, especially because of their importance or social position

example.en: Arriving late is a woman’s prerogative .
example.cn: 迟到是女人的特权。

enDef: admired as one of the best and most important

example.en: a prestigious literary award
example.cn: 享有盛名的文学奖

enDef: something that you think is true because it is very likely

example.en: She was enraged by his presumption.
example.cn: 她被他的放肆激怒了。

enDef: if someone or something is pretentious, they try to seem more important, intelligent, or high class than they really are in order to be impressive

example.en: a pretentious film
example.cn: 矫饰的电影

enDef: the soft inside part of a fruit or vegetable

example.en: Halve the melon and scoop out the pulp.
example.cn: 把瓜切成两半，挖出瓜瓤。

enDef: a small hole made accidentally in a tyre

example.en: She was cycling home when she had a puncture .
example.cn: 她骑车回家途中轮胎被扎破了。

enDef: having a strong taste or smell

example.en: He expressed some fairly pungent criticisms.
example.cn: 他提出了一针见血的批评。

enDef: to force people to leave a place or organization because the people in power do not like them

example.en: Anorexics may overeat before purging themselves or vomiting.
example.cn: 厌食症患者会在暴饮暴食之后服用泻药或者把吃下去的东西呕吐出来。

cn: 惩罚， 处罚； 判罚； 使处于不利地位
enDef: to punish someone or treat them unfairly

example.en: Women feel professionally penalized for taking time off to raise children.
example.cn: 女性认为休假带孩子在职业上对自己不利。

cn: 统治， 支配； 占优势
enDef: If one type of person or thing predominates in a group, there is more of that type of person or thing in the group than of any other

example.en: In older age groups women predominate because men tend to die younger.
example.cn: 在年龄较大的人群中，女性占多数，因为男性的寿命倾向于短些。

cn: 剽窃， 抄袭； 剽窃物
enDef: when someone uses another person’s words, ideas, or work and pretends they are their own

example.en: The journal accused the professor of plagiarism.
example.cn: 那份刊物指控该教授剽窃。

enDef: existing everywhere

example.en: the pervasive influence of television
example.cn: 电视无所不在的影响
